case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your proposals; we value our long-standing relationship and welcome the commitment of a 24-month contract. However, fixing the price for two years and delaying the effective date to April 2027 means we must ensure the rate remains sustainable for us.

We can offer a price of €51.80 per unit under the terms of your third option (30 days payment, 24 months, starting April 2027). For our complete Angebot, we specify a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

Please note that our offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your continued movement; we appreciate the constructive dialogue. For generations, our foundry has valued the deep, trust-based relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and it is a matter of personal pride for us to work together in a spirit of true partnership. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can take another step towards you and offer €50.70 for the 30-day payment term. To be precise, our current offer stands at a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are getting closer, and I am confident we can finalize this soon.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to reduce our price to €50.50 for the 30-day payment term. 

For our current Angebot, we state a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are nearing the end of our flexibility, but I am confident we can bridge this final gap. Our foundry takes immense pride in delivering the exact quality your pumps require, and I value the deep trust our companies have shared over many years. I look forward to finalizing this agreement together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser

Thank you for your latest proposal. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As your adjustment was very small this time, we can only take a modest step to €50.40 for the 30-day payment term. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Our family foundry values the long relationship we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we take immense pride in the quality of the work our people deliver to you. However, we are reaching the end of our flexibility, so I look forward to your steps to close this remaining gap.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
